what: Volatile alkyl-modified methylsiloxane fluid (INCI Caprylyl Methicone). The non-cyclic D4/D5-free volatile carrier used in sunscreens, serums, primers, hair oils, antiperspirants — the modern replacement for cyclopentasiloxane.
producers: Dow / DOWSIL FZ-3196 · Momentive Silsoft 034 · Shin-Etsu KF-… alkyl series · Elkem Mirasil C-DML · Siltech Silmer / Silwax · BRB Brasil · Jeen Jeesilc
silitex: No caprylyl methicone. Silitex 2026 Cosmetics catalogue offers the D5-replacement route the market is taking: C13-15 ALKANE (PO657), C15-19 ALKANE (PO599), ISODODECANE (PO709), TETRADECANE / DODECANE, ALCASUN VE (vegetal) and DIMETHICONE 1,5 cSt / DISILOXANE (volatile silicones). Also ALKABLEND 6800 (dimethiconol in C13-15 alkane).
history: Sold in volume by Sapirim (Dow Corning era) to Israeli cosmetics producers.
action: Offer alkanes / 1.5 cSt as the volatile carrier; ask Federica whether an alkyl methicone can be added for customers locked on FZ-3196.
note: Status revised 13/10/2026 after receiving the 5 Silitex sector catalogues (PDF). Website was outdated.
